narrative.overview: Kinotta is a dark table the owner lays someone else's reel on. The table itself is warm near-black and flat, divided by hairlines, and carries no hue, because every reel brings its own client's brand and the chrome must never tint the judgment of colour or motion. One cold ice-blue light moves over the table: it marks the pin you placed, the version on screen, the section in view, and the element under the cursor. Nothing else is lit.
keyCharacteristics: One light, never a fill: the ice blue marks state and never paints a surface.
Flat shell, stacked paper in hand: depth appears only on the hovered or focused shot, the enlarged sheet, and comment cards.
Numbers are machine type: every shot number, timecode, pin number and count is Doto with tabular figures.
Hexes are the only ornament: the cursor, the pins, the waiting mark and the brand mark share one hexagon.
Dot terrain is the only texture, and only where something is empty.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The ice blue marks state (pinned, current, hovered, waiting on its shape) and never fills a surface or decorates. If it isn't telling you where you are or what you touched, it isn't blue.

rules.name: The Neutral Frame Rule
rules.body: Anything that borders the reel (the well, the still ground, the scrim) is hueless, so the reel's own colour is judged against nothing.

rules.name: The Machine Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that identifies or measures (shot, pin, section, timecode, count) is Doto with tabular figures; prose numbers stay in Outfit.

rules.name: The In-Hand Rule
rules.body: Only what you are holding stacks: the shot under the pointer or focus, the enlarged sheet, and comment cards. Lanes, rails and panels stay flat.

dos: Do mark current and pinned state with the ice light and a second cue (shape, text or aria-current).
Do set every shot number, timecode, pin number and count in Doto with tabular figures.
Do keep Rubric's motion speeds on the chrome: lift 380ms, shadow 180ms, colour 250ms, press 120ms, one curve cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) (D19), and zero under reduced motion.
Do keep stepping shots, switching sections and keyboard navigation instant.
Do draw every outline, tag and pin in the editor, over the reel, never inside the reel's page.
donts: Don't fill a surface with the ice blue or use it as decoration.
Don't round a corner or use chrome-metal gradients.
Don't add texture other than dot terrain, and only in empty places.
Don't let the element name tag cover the element or the reel's content.
